text:
rachel: Heads-up — mobile SDKs reporting rapid WS reconnects to ap-southeast at ~06:12 UTC. Appears after yesterday's proxy tiny-change to treat idle probes as 204 responses.

priya: Are these true websocket closes or client-side timeouts?

rachel: Logs show proxy returning HTTP/1.1 204 during the probe handshake, client lib treats that as terminal and reopens immediately. That leads to reconnect storms and duplicate quota increments.

infra-bot: Alert created: ws-reopen-spike-apse-06:12. Paging eng-oncall.

tom: Can you paste the edge snippet?

rachel: sure — snip from edge trace: 

```
-> client ws handshake /v1/ws/connect
proxy: forward to backend
backend: 200 OK (held) -> later probe to backend returns 204
proxy log: "probe response: HTTP/1.1 204 No Content\nConnection: keep-alive"
client lib: emits close event, re-open
```

priya: So semantics changed: before we used SSE-style empty comment or kept the TCP alive with a pingback. Now 204 is considered non-upgrade and client closes.

harry: Consequence: metrics show session reopen rate x3, billing shows session create increments for each reopen. Our quota service increments per new websocket session id.

rachel: Example metric diffs: stream.conn.reopen_rate +300% in ap-southeast, billing.session.incremental_charges spike aligned.

ux: Console churn: operators see "connection closed" alerts per tenant. Can we make UX less noisy while we fix infra? Something like "probing observed — resuming" would reduce noise.

priya: Two tracks: short-term mitigation and long-term policy. Short-term: make proxy normalize probe -> a benign KEEPALIVE frame so clients don't treat as close. Also add a server-side dedupe in quota service so reconnects within a short window don't double-charge.

priya: Long-term: introduce routing policy flag `stream.keepalive_mode` with options: `legacy` (preserve old pingback comment), `compat` (proxy maps probe->keepalive), `strict` (204 means terminal). This lets us roll out semantics-aware changes per route.

harry: For client SDKs we should also add a tolerant mode: treat 204 during an in-flight upgrade as keepalive if header `X-Stream-Probation: 1` present. Ship as minor release.

priya: Proposed quota dedupe config (pseudo):

```
"quota_dedupe_window_ms": "7000",
"dedupe_keys": ["api_token", "client_uuid"],
"dedupe_behavior": "collapse_new_session_within_window"
```

priya: If policy `keepalive_mode=compat`, proxy will rewrite 204 -> 200 and emit an SSE-style comment for SSE or a noop frame for WS upgrades.

tom: Canary plan: ap-southeast only. rollout percentages: 0.5% -> 5% -> 50% -> 100%. Rollback triggers: reopen_rate > 4x baseline or billing.delta > 1.5x baseline or console.alerts > 2x. Capture metrics: `proxy.probe.204_rate`, `stream.conn.reopen_rate`, `billing.session.delta`, `console.alerts.stream_close`.

ux: I'll add a temporary console panel: "Reconnects by route" and a small note in the rollout UI: "keepalive semantics changed (compat)". Also create a transient alert rule suppressing tenant noisy alerts for affected routes while canary is in progress.

oncall-bot: Runbook linked. Muting alert for routes: /v1/ws/*:ap-southeast for 3h.

harry: Client SDK change: add header `X-Stream-Probation: 1` and treat 204 during handshake as keepalive if header present. Backwards compatible. I'll target a patch release today.

priya: I'll open PR to proxy to implement mapping and to quota-service for dedupe. Tagging @tom @rachel for review. Tom, can you own the canary?

tom: I can. I'll prepare rollout manifest and dashboards. ETA for first canary: 09:15 UTC.

rachel: Thanks. After canary, if stable, we'll add `stream.keepalive_mode` to routing policy and surface it in the Console route config. That way future probe-related changes are explicit.

harry: Also propose we add telemetry dimension `keepalive_mode` to all historical streaming metrics so we can split before/after behavior in analytics.

priya: Agreed. Action items: PR: proxy & quota (priya), SDK patch (harry), canary + metrics (tom), console panels & rollout annotation (ux). Aim to close loop by EOD if canary looks good.

rachel: Perfect. :thumbsup:
